article_content: The Rugby Football Union has appointed former England international Jon Callard to dual roles strengthening player development pathways. Effective September 1, the ex-fullback will serve as both National Performance Academy Manager and International Performance Coach, expanding his previous responsibilities within the RFU's coaching structure. Callard's focus will center on guiding the England Under-20 squad and supporting players progressing to the England Saxons team. The 48-year-old brings credentials from his playing career - including five Test caps beginning with his 1993 debut against New Zealand - complemented by coaching experience with Bath, Leeds, and England's Under-21 program. Joe Lydon, RFU's Head of International Player Development, stated: 'This new position enhances our support framework for emerging and established internationals. Jon's exceptional work with age-grade teams and demonstrated player development expertise positioned him as the prime candidate in a competitive selection process.'

Od 1. septembra, bivši bek preuzima dužnosti menadžera Nacionalne akademije i međunarodnog trenera, šireći svoje prethodne zadatke unutar saveza. Callard će voditi englesku U-20 reprezentaciju i pomagati igračima u napredovanju ka seniorskom timu England Saxons. Iskusan 48-godišnjak, koji je debitovao za Englesku protiv Novog Zelanda 1993. i skupio pet nastupa, donosi i trenersko iskustvo sa Bathom, Leedsom te engleskom U-21 selekcijom. Joe Lydon, RFU-ov šef razvoja igrača, istaknuo je: 'Ova nova pozicija osnažuje naš sistem podrške za buduće i sadašnje reprezentativce. Jonova uspješna saradnja s omladinskim timovima i dokazane vještine u razvoju talenata učinili su ga najboljim kandidatom među mnogim prijavljenima.'

article_content: Liverpool prospect Jerome Sinclair has revealed that Anfield legend Robbie Fowler is significantly influencing his development. Sinclair, 18, became Liverpool's youngest-ever player when making his debut aged 16 against West Brom in a September 2012 League Cup match. After injury setbacks, he's rebounded with 21 goals this season for Liverpool's youth teams. The striker, signed from West Brom in 2011, described Fowler's coaching as 'invaluable'. Sinclair told the Liverpool Echo: 'Robbie is a club legend. Learning from someone who reached the game's pinnacle improves my technique – he's helped refine my first touch and finishing.' Fowler, who scored 183 goals in 368 Liverpool appearances across two spells (1993-2001; 2006-2007), continues mentoring emerging talents. Training images recently showed Sinclair challenging defender Dejan Lovren.

article_content: As economic pressures mount, Americans are turning to backyard cultivation for both budgetary relief and practical education. Florida educator Susan Hopper uses her garden to teach students about food origins, continuing a tradition exemplified by Michelle Obama's White House kitchen garden and Eleanor Roosevelt's wartime victory gardens. The gardening surge shocks industry veterans, with Burpee & Co. reporting 25-30% increased vegetable seed sales. 'In 30 years, I've never witnessed such demand,' says CEO George Ball. While 43 million households now grow produce, savings estimates vary widely - the National Gardening Association projects $600 annual yields from $70 investments, contrasting with higher estimates cited elsewhere. New gardeners face steep learning curves. 'Many lack fundamental growing skills,' observes Bobby Wilson of the American Community Gardening Association. Texan Pamela Price battles drought while rediscovering ancestral farming knowledge, reflecting broader challenges. Community gardens offer solutions, with participation interest skyrocketing 500% this year according to NGA data.

Industriju iznenadila eksplozija interesa - kompanija Burpee bilježi 25-30% veću prodaju sjemena. 'U tridesetogodišnjem iskustvu nisam vidio ovakvo zanimanje,' priznaje direktor George Ball.
